provenance.heading: Where these details came from
provenance.unusable: We looked and could not read this from your site.

nothingAttributed.body: These details were set up before GOTCHA recorded where each one came from, so the next scan will ask you about every change instead of applying any. After that it refreshes what it wrote itself, without asking.

provenance.someAttributed: A scan refreshes the fields marked “From your website” on its own. Anything you entered stays as you left it, and you are asked before it changes.
provenance.oneLanguage: The AI replies in each customer's own language — that is a fixed rule, and this setting does not change it. GOTCHA stores one language here, and it is used to tag your knowledge documents.
